_about: The demo video's edit. 'cards' are drawn once by render-cards.js; 'segments' play in order. A clip is { take, in, out } (a file in video/takes, times from the start of the take as seconds or m:ss.s), optionally with fadeIn/fadeOut and a caption card over it (captionAt/captionUntil, seconds into the clip). A card segment is { card, duration }. 'target' is the length we're aiming for, and 'note' says what the clip should hold; build.js ignores both.

segments.note: the veil, the title page, 'Jacob Marlware was dead, to begin with.'
the chain heard, he hauls in, one or two of his lines, the chain dragged, Bring them now
the desktop dims and frosts; 'The bell has struck One. They come.'
'I am the Ghost of Downloads Past', the 2:14 a.m. invoice's card, an installer pleading, Lay to rest, the halo completing
'Have you never met my brothers?', a group arguing, This one is real, 'Impostors, begone!'
the candle finds him, the stone rises and is carved, the frost melted, the date struck out and carved later
the review, Wake up, the stone cracks, 'Git bless us, every one, and every zero.'
